This is a direct contradiction of the data gathered; Edward Albee lived 88 years and J. M. Barrie lived 77 years, meaning Edward Albee lived longer, not J. M. Barrie. The Planner failed to correctly map the calculated ages to the correct individuals in the final reasoning step.
